svg.title: Chat — Voice message pipeline: record → upload → process → broadcast (sequence)

g.text: Chat — Voice message pipeline: record → upload → process → broadcast (sequence)
stop; local duration < 0.5 s → discard (UX only)
process_message(id) (acks_late: redelivered if the worker dies)
UPDATE channels SET last_seq=last_seq+1 RETURNING last_seq
UPDATE messages SET status=ready, seq, duration_ms, waveform,
delete originals/{id} (processed copy is the source of truth)
publish message.ready {id, seq, sender, duration_ms, waveform}
